body:
Settings now work as the card does: every change saves by itself, and the header shows "Zapisano" in the same small indicator as on a card. The large "Zapisz ustawienia" button is gone, and the dialog stays open after a save.

What stays deliberate: if the settings changed somewhere else, the fields lock and the current settings have to be loaded by hand; the edits kept through that are saved only with their own button. A save whose result is unknown offers the status check and the identical retry. Adding a user is still its own button.

Checked: all 44 browser test suites and the smoke test pass, with the conflict and lost-reply cases rewritten for the new flow, and the header was looked at in the iPhone app on a simulator. The host is updated, so phones and browsers have it after reopening Settings.

Not checked: a physical phone.

Details: docs/ADR-078-SETTINGS-AUTOSAVE.md and progress/2026-10-10-settings-autosave.md.

metadata.summary: Settings save every change by themselves; the header shows Zapisano instead of a Save button
